title_en: At Gradient Residence, Dry Lake, Super Apartment 2+1+2 For Sale, With Fantastic View!!
description_en: At Gradient Residence, Dry Lake, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Fantastic View!!! The property is located on the 5th floor and has a total area of ​​195.62 m2, of which the net area is 129.55 m2 and the veranda area is 32.67 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a veranda. The orientation of the property is West, and it has a fantastic view of the Lake of Tirana. Along with the apartment, we also have 4 parking spaces with an extra value of 40,000 euros each. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, and offers every facility for a comfortable life.
